brief.text: Build an 8 m research vessel with a broad working stern, narrow raised bow, port-offset wheelhouse and open starboard deck. Shape a continuous curved hull with a visible chine, add a stern sampling crane and deck railings, and animate the crane carriage with its attached footplate and cable guide.

revisions.title: Initial vessel
revisions.description: First retained vessel source, with serviceOffset at 0.10.

revisions.title: Reviewed authoring revision
revisions.description: Moved serviceOffset to 0.25 and corrected two deck-shell winding expressions during the authoring run.

revisions.title: Previous gallery revision
revisions.description: A separate supplied-source refinement changed only serviceOffset from 0.25 to 0.40. All unrelated source bytes were preserved; a possible small mid-motion overlap remains a review limitation.

revisions.title: Flush faces fixed
revisions.description: Maintainer revision by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12): 1 part edit that separates faces lying on one plane, which flickered in any renderer. Materials, names, hierarchy and animation are unchanged.
